path_to_30: Add more positive specs from the same S2000 fixture (filter interval, radiator cap, coolant ratio, MTF fill procedure).
Add multi-vehicle fixtures when catalog grows (second synthetic vehicle) — still public fixtures only.
Add more hard misses / out-of-corpus questions (brake pad part numbers, OEM-only TSBs) expecting insufficient_evidence.
Add wiring-ish / procedure distractors once procedure sections exist in fixtures.
Add degrade-observation cases (operator notes when CE fails) without treating degrade as ablation.
Add negative polarity cases (wrong fluid type, never-mix) with explicit allowed evidence.
Split multi-hop / multi-section questions that require CE to prefer the right section over distractors.
Do not encode historical proxy ce_vs_rrf_delta_hits=+1 as baseline when adding cases.
debt: Grow toward ≥30 before portfolio-complete / freeze claims. Guide 02 DoD does not require 30.
